Query.Resource: ("RELAY SERVER INFORMATION")
"Report Generated: " & now as string
("Report Version: 1.0")

"BES Relay Version Counts: " & concatenation ", " of (it as string) of (it & "--" & (multiplicity of it as string)) of unique values of values whose (it contains ".") of results whose (not error flag of it and exists value of it) of bes property whose (name of it = "BES Relay Version" and name of site of source analysis of it = "BES Support") as string

"Number of Active BES Relays: " & number of computers of results from (bes properties "Last Report Time" whose (reserved flag of it)) whose (exists value of it and (now - value of it as time) < 1 * day) of (computers of results whose (exists value of it AND value of it as lowercase contains "yes") of bes properties "BES Relay Service Installed" whose (reserved flag of it)) as string

"Number of Computers Using Automatic Relay Selection: " & number of results whose (exists value of it AND value of it = "Automatic") of bes properties "BES Relay Selection Method" whose (reserved flag of it) as string

Result.Answer: Number of Computers Using Automatic Relay Selection: 2400

Query.Resource: "Number of Computers Using Manual Relay Selection: " & number of results whose (exists value of it AND value of it = "Manual") of bes properties "BES Relay Selection Method" whose (reserved flag of it) as string

Result.Answer: Number of Computers Using Manual Relay Selection: 137

Query.Resource: "Average Number of Clients per Relay: " & (if (exists it as integer) then it as integer else 0) of mean of multiplicities of unique values of values of results whose (exists value of it and value of it != "BES Root Server") of bes properties "Relay" whose (reserved flag of it) as string

Result.Answer: Average Number of Clients per Relay: 100

Query.Resource: "Maximum Number of Clients per Relay: " & ((if (exists results whose (exists value of it and value of it != "BES Root Server") of bes properties "Relay" whose (reserved flag of it)) then (maximum of multiplicities of unique values of values of results whose (exists value of it and value of it != "BES Root Server") of bes properties "Relay" whose (reserved flag of it)) else 0) as string)

Result.Answer: Maximum Number of Clients per Relay: 100

Query.Resource: "Minimum Number of Clients per Relay: " & ((if (exists results whose (exists value of it and value of it != "BES Root Server") of bes properties "Relay" whose (reserved flag of it)) then (minimum of multiplicities of unique values of values of results whose (exists value of it and value of it != "BES Root Server") of bes properties "Relay" whose (reserved flag of it)) else 0) as string)

Result.Answer: Minimum Number of Clients per Relay: 100

Query.Resource: "Distances to Relays: " & concatenation ", " of (it & "--" & (multiplicity of it as string)) of (unique values of ((values of results whose (exists value of it) of bes properties "Distance to BES Relay" whose (reserved flag of it));("255--" & (number of results whose (error flag of it) of bes properties "Distance to BES Relay" whose (reserved flag of it)) as string))) as string

"Average Distance to Relays: " & mean of (it as integer) of (values whose (exists it as integer) of results whose (exists value of it) of bes properties "Distance to BES Relay" whose (reserved flag of it)) as integer as string
"Number of Clients with Unknown Relay Distance: " & (number of results whose (error flag of it) of bes properties "Distance to BES Relay" whose (reserved flag of it)) as string

Result.Answer: Number of Clients with Unknown Relay Distance: 0

Query.Resource: "Maximum Distance to Relays: " & maximum of (it as integer) of (values whose (exists it as integer) of results whose (exists value of it) of bes properties "Distance to BES Relay" whose (reserved flag of it)) as string
"Latest relay Report Time timestamp: " & maximum of (last report time of it) of bes computers whose (relay server flag of it) as string

Result.Answer: Latest relay Report Time timestamp: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 08:25:06 -0400

Query.Resource: "Number of relays reported within the last 24 hours: " & number of bes computers whose (last report time of it > (now - (24* hour)) and relay server flag of it) as string

Result.Answer: Number of relays reported within the last 24 hours: 24

Query.Resource: "Number of relays reported within the last 1 hours: " & number of bes computers whose (last report time of it > (now - (1* hour)) and relay server flag of it) as string

Result.Answer: Number of relays reported within the last 1 hours: 24

Query.Resource: "Number of relays reported within the last 15 minutes: " & number of bes computers whose (last report time of it > (now - (15 * minute)) and relay server flag of it) as string

Result.Answer: Number of relays reported within the last 15 minutes: 24

Query.Resource: "Number of relays that have not reported within the last 1 hour: " & number of bes computers whose (last report time of it < (now - (60 * minute)) and relay server flag of it) as string

Result.Answer: Number of relays that have not reported within the last 1 hour: 0

Query.Resource: "Number of relays that have not reported within the last 1 day: " & number of bes computers whose (last report time of it < (now - (1440 * minute)) and relay server flag of it) as string

Result.Answer: Number of relays that have not reported within the last 1 day: 0

Query.Resource: "Number of relays that have not reported within the last 1 day: " & number of bes computers whose (last report time of it < (now - (10080 * minute)) and relay server flag of it) as string

Result.Answer: Number of relays that have not reported within the last 1 day: 0

Query.Resource: "Number of Relays with over 1000 Clients: " & number of (item 0 of it) of ((it, multiplicity of it) of unique values of (relay servers of it) of bes computers whose (exist relay server of it)) whose (item 1 of it > 1000) as string

Result.Answer: Number of Relays with over 1000 Clients: 0

Query.Resource: "Current Actionsite Version: " & (maximum of ((values of results from (bes properties whose (name of it = "BES Health Checks::Actionsite Version")) of bes computers whose (root server flag of it = TRUE)) as integer) as string)
("Relays with Stale Actionsite Versions (based upon BES Health Checks::Actionsite Version) - Version, Relay Name")

Result.Answer: Relays with Stale Actionsite Versions (based upon BES Health Checks::Actionsite Version) - Version, Relay Name

Query.Resource: (concatenation "" of ((name of computer of item 1 of it & " - " & value of item 1 of it)) of (maximum of ((values of results from (bes properties whose (name of it = "BES Health Checks::Actionsite Version")) of bes computers whose (root server flag of it = TRUE)) as integer) , results whose (exists value of it) of bes properties whose (name of it = "BES Health Checks::Actionsite Version" )) whose (value of item 1 of it as integer < item 0 of it as integer))
("Relay Server Aggregation Statistics (Total Child Count) - Relay Name, Number of Machines")

Result.Answer: Relay Server Aggregation Statistics (Total Child Count) - Relay Name, Number of Machines

Query.Resource: (item 0 of it, item 1 of it as string) of ((it, multiplicity of it) of unique values of (relay server of it) of bes computers whose (exist relay server of it)) as string
("Relay Server Aggregation Statistics (Client Child Count) - Relay Name, Number of Machines")

Result.Answer: Relay Server Aggregation Statistics (Client Child Count) - Relay Name, Number of Machines

Query.Resource: (item 0 of it, item 1 of it as string) of ((it, multiplicity of it) of unique values of (relay server of it) of bes computers whose (exist relay server of it AND not relay server flag of it)) as string
("Relay Server Aggregation Statistics (Relay Child Count) - Relay Name, Number of Machines")

Result.Answer: Relay Server Aggregation Statistics (Relay Child Count) - Relay Name, Number of Machines

Query.Resource: (item 0 of it, item 1 of it as string) of ((it, multiplicity of it) of unique values of (relay server of it) of bes computers whose (exist relay server of it AND relay server flag of it)) as string
